_note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only dictionary/variable assignments. It defines model architecture settings for SETR (Segmenter using TRansformer) naive variant. There are no functions, classes, or callable APIs — it is a list of configuration variables imported by the MMSegmentation framework.
summarize_model_config: summarize the SETR naive model config for semantic segmentation with VisionTransformer backbone
review_backbone_settings: review the VisionTransformer backbone settings with 1024 embed dims and 24 layers
review_decode_head: review the SETRUPHead decode head configuration with 256 channels and 19 classes
review_auxiliary_heads: review the three auxiliary SETRUPHead configs with loss weight 0.4 each
review_data_preprocessor: review the SegDataPreProcessor settings with ImageNet mean and std normalization
